papers.title: NAS-PO: Native Attention-Strategy Policy Optimization for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an effective post-training paradigm for vision-language models (VLMs). Standard RLVR, however, assigns identical outcome-derived credit to all generated tokens regardless of their perceptual relevance. Recent perception-aware methods estimate visual reliance through image perturbation or masking. These indirect proxies require perturbation branches, while corruption sensitivity does not necessarily identify the visual evidence used for reasoning. We instead shape model perception through native attention, an intrinsic model signal. Rather than treating attention as a post-hoc explanation, we formulate it as a reward-anchored, token-aligned routing signal that encourages attention patterns supporting visually grounded reasoning. To this end, we propose NAS-PO, a Native Attention-Strategy Policy Optimization framework. NAS-PO analyzes native attention with a visual mass policy that quantifies visual allocation and a conditional visual policy that captures spatial routing over visual tokens, making the optimization well-posed. Based on this, Native Attention-Strategy Advantage Shaping (NAS-AS) draws on the visual-mass policy to redistribute signed policy-gradient credit for visually engaged rollouts. The Adaptive Attention-Coupled (AAC) loss then aligns the visual-mass policy on all response tokens and the conditional visual policy on visually active ones, consolidating the visual-routing patterns that drive successful trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that NAS-PO substantially surpasses leading RL-tuned VLMs across 7 out-of-domain reasoning and perception benchmarks, with its effectiveness consistently validated across 8B and 32B. Visual-Routing Sensitivity (VRS) analysis further indicates that the optimized attention prioritizes visually load-bearing regions.

summary.takeaway: 提出NAS-PO，利用模型原生注意力作为奖励锚定的token级路由信号，替代基于图像扰动的间接视觉依赖代理，以强化视觉语言模型中视觉接地的推理。
summary.methods: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）后训练范式；用视觉质量策略和条件视觉策略分析原生注意力，设计NAS-AS优势塑形和AAC损失；在7个域外推理与感知基准上评估8B和32B模型。
summary.relevance: 直接关联强化学习与多模态学习主题，聚焦视觉语言模型的RL对齐与跨模态理解。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明具体基准名称、训练数据规模和计算开销；注意力策略的有效性依赖模型原生注意力质量，其泛化边界未在摘要中讨论。

papers.title: Attribution-based diagnostics for single-cell foundation models
papers.abstract: Single-cell RNA foundation models (scFMs) are increasingly used for in-silico biological discovery, yet predictive performance alone does not reveal whether their decisions rely on biologically meaningful signals or model-specific shortcuts. We systematically investigate post-hoc attribution of downstream predictions across two tasks: cell-type annotation using pretrained Cell2Sentence and scGPT models, and perturbation prediction using scGPT+STATE in a controlled setting. For cell annotation, we use attribution to assess whether predictions rely on established marker genes and how their relevance varies with model architecture, expression rank, and the surrounding cellular context. For perturbation prediction, we compare attribution patterns with known regulatory ground-truth in a synthetic setting to assess what they reveal about the model's learned computations. Across these tasks, attribution reveals biological feature use, contextual interactions, contributions from different input pathways, learning progression, associations with prediction quality, and potential pitfalls that are not fully captured by standard performance metrics. Experiments with complete and limited regulatory knowledge further demonstrate that conclusions drawn from attribution depend strongly on the choice of biological reference, baseline, and null model. Together, these findings highlight the value of attribution as a flexible post-hoc diagnostic for understanding model behavior, identifying potential issues, and informing the development of scFMs.

summary.takeaway: 系统评估单细胞基础模型下游预测的事后归因，揭示归因可反映生物特征使用、上下文交互和学习进程，但结论强烈依赖生物参考、基线和零模型的选择。
summary.methods: 在细胞类型注释任务中使用预训练Cell2Sentence和scGPT，在扰动预测中使用scGPT+STATE；比较归因模式与已知调控真值，并测试完整与有限调控知识下的结论稳定性。
summary.relevance: 关联单细胞扰动、Cell Foundation Model和预训练主题，为理解模型决策提供诊断工具。
summary.caveat: 扰动预测仅在合成受控设置中验证；归因结论对参考和基线选择敏感，摘要未提供定量性能提升或跨数据集泛化证据。

papers.title: Bridging CLIP with DINO: Cross-Modal Information Maximization for Online Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract: Vision-language models such as CLIP enable zero-shot classification from arbitrary class names, but under test-time corruptions, their visual encoder projects distorted features onto incorrect textual anchors with high confidence: a phenomenon we term modality bias. Standard entropy minimization reinforces these overconfident errors, which creates a confirmation-bias loop and collapses the predicted label distribution. We propose an online test-time adaptation (TTA) method that breaks this loop at three levels. At the representation level, a frozen self-supervised backbone (e.g., DINO v2) is combined with CLIP through a cross-covariance logit ensemble. CLIP text prototypes are projected into the feature space of this text-free backbone, so the self-supervised branch classifies native image features and is less affected by the text bias of CLIP. At the optimization level, a gated test-time information-maximization objective pairs per-sample sharpening with batch-level diversity, while an adaptive gate excludes unreliable samples from the gradient. At the prediction level, an online logit adjustment corrects the residual class-distribution skew. CDIM outperforms the compared CLIP-based online TTA baselines on ImageNet-C, CIFAR10-C, and CIFAR100-C, and remains competitive in continual and mixed-domain TTA. Extensive analyses and ablation studies verify the contribution of each of its components. Our code is available at https://github.com/B1ueC1oud/CDIM

summary.takeaway: 提出CDIM在线测试时适应方法，通过结合冻结自监督骨干DINO v2与CLIP的跨协方差logit集成、门控信息最大化目标和在线logit调整，打破模态偏差导致的确认偏差循环。
summary.methods: 在表示层融合CLIP文本原型与DINO v2特征空间；优化层采用逐样本锐化与批级多样性及自适应门控；预测层进行在线logit调整；在ImageNet-C、CIFAR10-C、CIFAR100-C及持续和混合域TTA上评估。
summary.relevance: 关联持续适应与预训练、多模态学习和跨模态理解主题，针对CLIP在测试时损坏下的适应问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体准确率数值或相对提升幅度；方法依赖额外冻结自监督骨干，计算成本未讨论。

papers.title: E-GenRM: Generative Reward Modeling for Open-Ended E-Commerce Shopping Agents
papers.abstract: We present E-GenRM (E-commerce Generative Reward Model), a generative reward model tailored to e-commerce shopping agents. User expectations are shifting from simple product queries to open-ended shopping tasks. However, existing trajectories and reward designs remain largely bounded by current agent usage patterns and known failures, providing limited guidance for further capability improvement. These limitations call for an integrated reward modeling framework for open-ended shopping agent tasks. On the data side, E-GenRM leverages naturally occurring user behavior across the shopping app to construct diverse, long-horizon conversational trajectories beyond established usage patterns. On the modeling side, E-GenRM first learns from behavior-grounded evaluation chains through supervised fine-tuning. It is then optimized through criterion-guided reinforcement learning, which rewards correct preference judgments and evidence-supported factual claims under each criterion. Personalized hard-negative training further improves its sensitivity to user preferences reflected in shopping behavior, beyond explicit requirements. We additionally develop an active evidence retrieval extension that acquires missing e-commerce information for evaluation. On E-GenRM-Bench, E-GenRM-27B achieves 87.40\% preference accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.97 percentage points. In a 14-day online A/B test on Taobao, a shopping agent post-trained with E-GenRM improves the effective shopping-assistance rate by 1.39 percentage points and user satisfaction by 2.33 percentage points.

summary.takeaway: 提出E-GenRM，面向开放式电商购物智能体的生成式奖励模型，利用真实用户行为构建长程轨迹，并通过监督微调、准则引导强化学习和个性化难负例训练提升偏好判断与事实依据能力。
summary.methods: 从购物应用用户行为构建对话轨迹；行为 grounded 评估链监督微调；准则引导RL优化偏好判断和证据支持的事实主张；个性化难负例训练；主动证据检索扩展；在E-GenRM-Bench和淘宝14天在线A/B测试评估。
summary.relevance: 关联检索增强与对齐、强化学习和多智能体与奖励学习主题，聚焦电商智能体的奖励建模。
summary.caveat: 在线A/B测试结果依赖特定平台和部署环境；摘要未说明离线基准的覆盖范围和模型规模对结论的影响。

papers.title: JHiMA-WebRL: A Joint Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
papers.abstract: Multimodal web agents have shown promising capabilities for interacting with websites through graphical user interfaces (GUIs), yet realistic web tasks often require long-horizon, multi-step planning that remains challenging for monolithic policies. Such agents must jointly infer high-level plans, navigate through intermediate states, track progress over extended interaction histories, and execute visually grounded actions. Although prior work has explored modular multi-agent systems with a separate planner, the planner is typically not updated jointly with the actor. We investigate whether explicitly separating and jointly training planning and execution provides a stronger inductive bias for long-horizon web navigation. We introduce JHiMA-WebRL, a joint hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for web agents that couples a task decomposer with an actor. To train the decomposer, we use a strong teacher model to construct structured subtask supervision from multimodal GUI trajectories, and use these annotations to fine-tune both the decomposer and the subtask-conditioned actor. We then extend Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to jointly optimize the decomposer and actor in the interactive WebArena environment through hierarchical rollout grouping and role-specific advantages. On WebArena-Lite-v2, JHiMA-WebRL-14B, consisting of a 7B actor and a 7B decomposer, achieves an average success rate of 37.2%, compared with 24% for a ScaleCUA-32B agent that we fine-tune with RL on the same training tasks and evaluate under the same protocol. Ablations show that jointly updating the decomposer during RL outperforms updating the actor alone. These results suggest that jointly learned role factorization with smaller models can be a competitive alternative to scaling monolithic agents for long-horizon web tasks.

summary.takeaway: 提出JHiMA-WebRL，联合训练任务分解器与子任务条件执行器的层次多智能体强化学习框架，证明显式分离并联合优化规划与执行可为长程网页导航提供更强归纳偏置。
summary.methods: 用强教师模型从多模态GUI轨迹构建结构化子任务监督，微调分解器和执行器；扩展GRPO进行层次 rollout 分组和角色特定优势的联合优化；在WebArena-Lite-v2上评估7B执行器+7B分解器。
summary.relevance: 关联检索增强与对齐、强化学习和多智能体与奖励学习主题，针对长程网页任务的多智能体RL。
summary.caveat: 仅在WebArena-Lite-v2单一环境评估；教师模型构建监督的质量和成本未在摘要中讨论；与更大规模单体智能体的比较限于特定基线。

papers.title: Dr. No: Feature Steering for Abstention in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Large foundation models often answer even when the available visual or textual evidence is insufficient to support a reliable conclusion. This failure to abstain makes them hard to trust in high-stakes or information-seeking settings, where a confident but unsupported answer can be worse than no answer at all. It also raises a natural question: can the internal mechanisms behind this behaviour be identified and controlled at inference time? We present Dr. No, a feature-steering approach that mines sparse autoencoder (SAE) features associated with abstention and commitment, then modulates a small set of them during the prefill pass, without retraining the base model. Dr. No is evaluated on LLaVA-1.6 Mistral 7B across multimodal abstention benchmarks, including UNK-VQA and MM-UPD, and additionally benchmarked on language reasoning tasks using Qwen3.5-2B on AbstentionBench subsets. Against multiple uncertainty-based abstention baselines, feature steering achieves a more favourable balance between correct answering and appropriate abstention than post-hoc rejection methods. The gains are strongest on UNK-VQA and on MM-UPD cases involving image--question or question--answer incompatibility, and transfer most clearly to mathematical reasoning subsets of AbstentionBench. However, performance is more limited on absent-answer detection and retrieval-heavy multi-hop QA, such as MuSiQue. These results suggest that sparse internal features provide lightweight control handles for shaping uncertainty-aware behaviour in foundation models, while also showing that abstention control is source-dependent rather than governed by a single universal signal.

summary.takeaway: 提出Dr. No，通过稀疏自编码器挖掘与弃答和承诺相关的特征，并在预填充阶段调制少量特征，无需重训练即可在推理时控制视觉语言模型的弃答行为。
summary.methods: 在LLaVA-1.6 Mistral 7B上评估多模态弃答基准UNK-VQA和MM-UPD；在Qwen3.5-2B上评估AbstentionBench子集；与多种基于不确定性的弃答基线比较。
summary.relevance: 关联预训练、多模态学习和跨模态理解与生成主题，关注基础模型的不确定性感知行为控制。
summary.caveat: 在缺失答案检测和检索密集型多跳QA（如MuSiQue）上性能有限；弃答控制是来源依赖的，不存在单一通用信号；摘要未提供所有基准的定量结果。

papers.title: PGuard: A Native, Streaming, and Plug-in Guardrail for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: As streaming generation becomes the dominant serving paradigm for both text-only and multimodal large language models, ensuring safety throughout the generation process has become a critical challenge. We introduce PGuard, a native, streaming, and plug-in guardrail that transforms safety monitoring from an external serving dependency into an integrated capability of the backbone model. PGuard directly leverages the backbone's intermediate representations for token-level safety detection, without altering its original inference pathway or generation behavior. Specifically, dynamic layer gating selectively aggregates residual-stream representations across layers to extract safety-relevant signals during both prefill and autoregressive decoding. To balance detection accuracy and computational efficiency, PGuard supports multiple representation-modeling architectures, including a lightweight stateless variant and sequence-aware variants built on multi-scale causal EMA-attention and GRU-based recurrent modules. Its design also accounts for the execution characteristics of LLM serving frameworks, such as SGLang, optimizing computation and data access to minimize additional runtime and synchronization overhead. As a result, PGuard incurs only 0.82-2.26% end-to-end overhead on the hundred-billion-parameter backbone Qwen3.5-122B-A10B served by SGLang. Extensive evaluations across more than 30 benchmarks spanning text and multimodal safety, jailbreaks, cyber and CBRN risks, multilingual scenarios, and real-world traffic demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among native guardrails. On text queries with Qwen3.5-9B, PGuard achieves an average F1 score of 0.836, approaching dedicated external guardrails, while supporting deployment-time configuration of category-specific thresholds and enforcement actions.

papers.title: Finite-Sample Convergence in Networked Average Reward MARL: Decentralization Pitfalls and Entropy Remedies
papers.abstract: We study the problem of average reward Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) where agents interact within a network. Each agent in the network conducts local updates with information within its $k$-hop neighborhood and collaboratively maximizes the overall reward of the entire network. We first provide impossibility results in achieving convergence to the global optimal joint policies in our setting. These impossibility results highlight the challenges of decentralized learning with local information in multi-agent systems, namely the issues of multiagency, where each agent independently optimizes its policy, and partial observability, where agents have limited visibility into the global state. Given these challenges which indicate that decentralized policy optimization can generally be certified only up to stationarity, we provide finite-sample convergence guarantees for a decentralized actor-critic algorithm with linear function approximation that converges to an approximate stationary point with small gradient norm. To overcome such impossibility results, we further show that adding fixed-state entropy regularization reshapes the objective landscape which leads to even stronger global convergence guarantees for our proposed actor-critic algorithm.

summary.takeaway: 研究网络化平均奖励多智能体强化学习，给出分散式学习收敛到全局最优联合策略的不可能性结果，并为线性函数近似的分散actor-critic提供有限样本收敛保证，进一步证明固定状态熵正则化可重塑目标 landscape 以获得更强全局收敛保证。
summary.methods: 分析k跳邻域局部信息下的分散式策略优化；建立不可能性结果；对分散actor-critic算法给出收敛到小梯度范数近似稳定点的有限样本保证；引入固定状态熵正则化。
summary.relevance: 关联强化学习和多智能体与奖励学习主题，提供网络化MARL的理论收敛分析。
summary.caveat: 结果为理论保证，摘要未提供实验验证；线性函数近似和特定网络结构假设可能限制实际适用性。

papers.title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
papers.abstract: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

summary.takeaway: 提出HistoTx，一种早期融合视觉Transformer架构，将空间转录组令牌与图像块令牌在共享Transformer中联合处理，实现深度跨模态交互。
summary.methods: 基于预训练的纯视觉病理基础模型，在配对的图像和空间转录组数据上继续自监督预训练；转录组令牌可在任意空间分辨率构建并与图像块令牌合并。
summary.relevance: 该工作与预训练、自监督与表示学习、跨模态理解与生成主题相关，展示了如何将转录组作为真正输入模态而非仅训练信号进行多模态融合。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体数据集名称、量化性能指标或模型规模等细节；仅报告了相对基线的比较结果，未说明计算成本或泛化性限制。

papers.title: Dataset Recommendation for Heterogeneous and Dynamic Scholarly Graphs via Multimodal Representation Learning
papers.abstract: Researchers struggle to find relevant datasets amid the growing volume of data across repositories and scholarly publications. Manual dataset retrieval is time-consuming and often fails to identify valuable resources that are not easily discoverable through direct links or popularity metrics. Dataset recommendation, which aims to identify datasets relevant to a paper, author, or query, has become essential for improving dataset discoverability and reuse. However, this task remains challenging because Scholarly Knowledge Graphs (SKGs) are large-scale, heterogeneous, dynamic, and incomplete. Although openly available SKGs organize scientific knowledge by linking scholarly outcomes, they often lack meaningful connections between datasets, leaving them isolated and underutilized. These graphs contain millions of evolving relations but still suffer from missing or inaccurate metadata, duplicate records, and weak dataset integration. This work presents the Multimodal Scholarly Attention Network (MM-SAN), a heterogeneous multimodal graph representation learning method for recommending datasets relevant to research publications within real-world SKGs. MM-SAN combines topology-aware and text-based embeddings, enabling effective recommendations even when textual metadata is limited or absent. It operates in transductive, semi-inductive, and fully inductive settings, adapting to evolving SKGs without requiring retraining. Experiments show that MM-SAN outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing a robust and scalable solution for dataset recommendation.

summary.takeaway: 提出MM-SAN，一种异构多模态图表示学习方法，用于在真实学术知识图谱中推荐相关数据集，支持直推、半归纳和全归纳设置。
summary.methods: 结合拓扑感知和基于文本的嵌入，利用多模态学术注意力网络处理大规模、异构、动态且不完整的学术知识图谱。
summary.relevance: 与知识图谱、图谱构建与表示、自监督与表示学习主题相关，针对学术知识图谱中数据集孤立和元数据缺失问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提及具体实验数据集、评估指标或与基线方法的详细对比数值；未讨论模型可扩展性的具体限制。

papers.title: OCR in the Foundation Model Era: From Specialist Models to Unified Models
papers.abstract: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is among the oldest and most widely deployed applications of artificial intelligence. This survey reviews its development, focusing on the Foundation Model Era. We define OCR through faithful transcription: within a specified visual scope, OCR should completely reconstruct the text, notation, and document structure observable in the source image, and every textual, notational, or structural element in the output must be verifiable from visual evidence in that image. We trace the development from specialist OCR models toward unified models, examining joint text detection and recognition, structured sequence generation, and the use of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs). We organize contemporary OCR systems into five coexisting families: modular toolkits and task-specific models, specialized document VLMs, hybrid workflows, general-purpose VLMs, and commercial products and managed services. We compare their architectures, data, and training, examining hallucination and omission, insufficient spatial grounding, and inference cost in generative OCR. We review evaluation from character and scene text recognition to parsing individual structural elements and full-page transcription, highlighting gaps in consistent output definitions, attribution of performance to individual components, and coverage of real capture conditions and visible content and structure. Finally, we summarize the challenges facing OCR and discuss directions for future research. We continuously track related work at https://github.com/zhihengli-casia/Awesome-OCR-in-the-Foundation-Model-Era.

summary.takeaway: 综述基础模型时代的OCR发展，将当代OCR系统分为五类共存家族，并讨论生成式OCR中的幻觉、遗漏、空间 grounding 不足和推理成本等问题。
summary.methods: 通过文献综述方式，追溯从专用OCR模型到统一模型的发展，比较架构、数据和训练方法，并回顾评估方法。
summary.relevance: 与检索增强与对齐、预训练、多模态学习、跨模态理解与生成主题相关，涵盖视觉-语言模型在OCR中的应用。
summary.caveat: 作为综述，不提供新的实验结果；摘要指出评估中存在输出定义不一致、性能归因困难和真实采集条件覆盖不足等 gaps。

papers.title: Findings-aware Language-Image Pretraining for CT Volume Interpretation
papers.abstract: Computed tomography (CT) provides diverse patient information and various clinical tasks, for which numerous deep learning models have been investigated. Recent years have seen the development of vision-language foundation models that can comprehensively extract clinical features, driven by representation learning that combines CT volumes with radiology reports. Existing approaches typically adopt Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP)-based representation learning, where pairs from different cases are, in principle, treated as negative pairs such that the volume and report embeddings are pushed apart. In the biomedical imaging, however, treating different cases as negative pairs is not always appropriate, particularly when clinical similarity exists. In this study, we propose a supervised representation learning framework grounded in clinical knowledge from language foundation models, rather than the weak supervision used in CLIP. Specifically, we utilized a large language model to extract abnormal finding phrases from reports. We then explicitly constructed the target features that the image encoder should output, as the semantic representation of the extracted findings using a biomedical text embedding model. Our Findings-aware Language-Image Pre-training (FiLIP) outperformed weakly supervised approaches in multi-label zero-shot finding classification in both in-domain and external-domain evaluations, and also proved effective when fine-tuned for the downstream task of radiology report generation.

summary.takeaway: 提出FiLIP，一种基于临床知识的监督表示学习框架，利用大语言模型提取异常发现短语并构建目标特征，优于弱监督CLIP方法。
summary.methods: 使用大语言模型从放射报告中提取异常发现短语，并用生物医学文本嵌入模型生成语义表示作为图像编码器的目标特征；在多标签零样本发现分类和报告生成任务上评估。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型、预训练、自监督与表示学习、跨模态理解与生成主题相关，改进CT体积与报告的多模态预训练。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体数据集名称、模型规模或详细数值结果；仅报告了优于弱监督方法，未讨论计算开销或临床部署限制。

papers.title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Submodular Trajectory Rewards
papers.abstract: We study cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning with decoupled dynamics and a monotone submodular reward function over joint trajectories. Due to the non-additive reward, an optimal policy may depend on the history of all agents. This dependence makes exact optimization exponential in the horizon and the number of agents. To overcome this challenge while retaining theoretical guarantees, we introduce pre-window curvature $c_m$, which quantifies how states visited more than $m$ steps earlier reduce current marginal gains. Using this curvature to control the error from restricting the policy of each agent to depend only on its last $m+1$ states, we propose a greedy algorithm that exploits the decoupled dynamics to optimize local policies sequentially. For fixed $m$, the algorithm achieves a $\frac{1-c_m}{2-c_m}$ approximation guarantee up to estimation error, and its computation time is polynomial in the number of agents and the horizon. We recover the known $1/2$-factor approximation for time-additive rewards and obtain an approximation factor no smaller than the known total-curvature bound for a single agent. We formulate multi-agent traffic monitoring as an example of this framework and evaluate our algorithm on it.

summary.takeaway: 研究具有单调子模奖励的合作多智能体强化学习，引入预窗口曲率c_m，提出贪心算法在固定m下获得(1-c_m)/(2-c_m)近似保证。
summary.methods: 利用解耦动态顺序优化局部策略，将每个智能体的策略限制为仅依赖最近m+1个状态，计算时间关于智能体数和horizon多项式；以多智能体交通监控为例评估。
summary.relevance: 与强化学习、多智能体与奖励学习主题直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供实验的具体设置、基线对比或数值结果；近似保证依赖于曲率c_m和估计误差，实际性能可能受这些因素影响。

papers.title: Heads That Write, Not Just Point: Image Retrieval Heads in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) can process interleaved text and multiple images in a single context, but how they internally identify the image relevant to a question remains poorly understood. We study this grounding step as in-context image retrieval and introduce ICIR-MCQ, a controlled probe for head-level analysis of image retrieval. Using each head's attention mass over image-token spans, we first identify sparse pointer heads that reliably point to the target image. These heads transfer beyond the probe: a single pointer head is competitive with external vision-language retrievers on a naturalistic multi-image retrieval benchmark, showing that LVLMs contain a strong internal image retrieval signal. Attention alone, however, shows where a head reads from, not what its output passes on to later layers, so we introduce a complementary output-side analysis. For each head, we train a lightweight image retriever on its value-weighted output and use it to identify writer heads, whose outputs contain enough information to identify the target image. Surprisingly, the pointer and writer criteria select substantially different head sets, with only 35 to 47 heads overlapping among the top-100 heads under each criterion. Targeted set-partition ablations show that the heads most important for standard multi-image inference are concentrated in this pointer-writer intersection, while heads selected by only one criterion show less consistent separation from random-head controls. The most consistent causal effects arise from heads selected by both the attention-based pointer and output-side writer criteria. Code and data: https://github.com/parkquasar/Image-Retrieval-Heads.

summary.takeaway: 研究LVLM中的上下文图像检索，发现稀疏指针头和写入头，二者重叠有限，且同时满足两种标准的头对多图像推理因果影响最一致。
summary.methods: 引入ICIR-MCQ探针，基于注意力质量识别指针头；通过训练轻量图像检索器于头的值加权输出识别写入头；进行集合划分消融实验。
summary.relevance: 与多模态学习、跨模态理解与生成主题相关，揭示LVLM内部图像 grounding 机制。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明模型规模、数据集细节或重叠头数量的具体统计显著性；因果结论基于消融实验，可能受探针设计限制。

papers.title: BtsPruner: Role-Aware Visual Token Pruning for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) often process hundreds or thousands of visual tokens, resulting in substantial computational and memory overhead during inference. Existing training-free pruning methods typically estimate token importance using language-model attention, visual attention, or feature similarity. However, these methods treat visual tokens with uniform criteria and overlook that tokens may serve different roles during visual encoding. In this work, we investigate the evolution of visual token roles in LVLMs and observe that tokens progressively transition from local detail carriers to globally referenced representatives as encoding proceeds. Based on this observation, we propose BtsPruner, a training-free role-aware visual token pruning framework that preserves complementary token roles under a fixed budget. Specifically, BtsPruner first identifies the token-role transition point based on the evolution of attention concentration. It then discovers globally referenced representatives from later encoding stages and recursively retrieves local detail tokens from earlier stages to recover complementary fine-grained evidence. Extensive experiments across LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT, Qwen-VL, InternVL, and CogVLM demonstrate that BtsPruner achieves superior performance retention under aggressive token reduction. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, BtsPruner preserves 91.6% of the dense model's performance using only 32 of 576 visual tokens (5.6%). In the high-resolution LLaVA-NeXT-7B setting, it achieves up to a 5.95x CUDA-latency speedup.

summary.takeaway: 提出BtsPruner，一种无需训练的角色感知视觉令牌剪枝框架，在固定预算下保留互补令牌角色，实现高效推理。
summary.methods: 基于注意力集中度演化识别令牌角色转换点，从后期编码阶段发现全局引用代表，并递归从早期阶段检索局部细节令牌；在多个LVLM上实验。
summary.relevance: 与多模态学习、跨模态理解与生成主题相关，针对LVLM推理计算和内存开销问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告了在LLaVA-1.5-7B上仅用32/576个视觉令牌保留91.6%性能及最高5.95倍加速，但未说明在其他模型上的具体保留率或加速比，也未讨论剪枝对细粒度任务的影响。

papers.title: Entropy-Gated Dynamic Rectification for Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) routinely name objects that are absent from the image. Latent steering can reduce this failure in one model forward pass, but a fixed gate treats early and late decoding steps by the same criterion. We observe that predictive entropy varies sharply within free-running generation, while states that commit to short answers occupy a narrow, confident band. We exploit this temporal mismatch by using uncertainty as a causally available, token-local control signal for an existing steering gate. We propose Entropy-Gated Dynamic Rectification (EGDR), which lowers the intervention threshold when entropy derived from the preceding step's already available logits is high and retains the calibrated operating point when it is low. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, the underlying static gate lowers CHAIR CS/CI from 53.00/15.30 to 32.00/14.30; replacing only its constant threshold with EGDR further lowers them to 29.00/13.60. At a matched 58% intervention rate, the corresponding static control obtains 30.50/14.00. The gain over the static gate holds on LLaVA-NeXT-7B and grows with the generation budget, while POPE scores and general multimodal capability remain effectively unchanged. EGDR requires no additional model forward pass and adds roughly 2% measured latency. Our code is available at https://github.com/alvi-uiu/EGDR.

summary.takeaway: 提出熵门控动态校正（EGDR），利用预测熵作为令牌局部控制信号动态调整干预阈值，减少LVLM中的对象幻觉。
summary.methods: 基于前一步已可用logits计算熵，在高熵时降低干预阈值，低熵时保持校准工作点；在LLaVA-1.5-7B和LLaVA-NeXT-7B上评估。
summary.relevance: 与多模态学习、跨模态理解与生成主题相关，针对LVLM幻觉问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要显示在LLaVA-1.5-7B上CHAIR CS/CI从静态门的32.00/14.30降至29.00/13.60，但未报告在其他模型上的具体数值；增益随生成预算增长，但未讨论长生成中的累积误差或计算开销的详细分析。

papers.title: Sketchpad: certified exact arithmetic with a small vision-language model
papers.abstract: Language models are accurate on most long-arithmetic problems, but their accuracy is estimated on samples and carries no guarantee for an unseen input; tool use is exact but moves the computation outside the network. We show that exactness at all input lengths becomes a finite, checkable property of a network when each of its steps reads only a bounded view of an external working memory. In Sketchpad, Qwen3.5-0.8B with a low-rank adapter executes arithmetic procedures on a rendered sheet. Each forward pass reads a three-cell view and emits one step: a digit, a carry or borrow, and the next operation. A fixed runtime moves the view and writes no digit of a result. We prove in Lean that the model is then exact on all inputs of any length if and only if it is exact on the finite set of views the runtime presents, that no finite test suffices when steps also read earlier steps, and that the guarantee tolerates bounded numerical perturbation and extends to compositions of procedures. All 2,446 views pass on the deployment device, a laptop GPU running the model in a web browser. The certified model performs signed addition and subtraction, long multiplication and division, square roots and greatest common divisors at arbitrary length. It solved 200 of 200 pre-registered problems in the browser, and 220 of 220 sums of up to 1,000 digits and products of up to 20 digits, of which GPT-6.1 Sol, the strongest of ten other models, solved 217. A symbolic runtime built on these procedures solves, expands and factors polynomials with every number computed by the model, and a multiplicative gate on the adapter recovers the base model exactly when the sheet is not in use.

summary.takeaway: 提出Sketchpad，通过将算术步骤限制为读取外部工作内存的有限视图，使得小规模视觉语言模型在Lean中可证明对所有长度输入精确，并在浏览器中部署验证。
summary.methods: 使用Qwen3.5-0.8B加低秩适配器，在渲染的纸张上执行算术过程；每次前向传播读取三单元格视图并输出一步；用Lean证明精确性等价于有限视图集上的精确性；在笔记本电脑GPU的浏览器中测试2446个视图及多类算术问题。
summary.relevance: 涉及多模态学习与跨模态理解，展示视觉语言模型在结构化任务中的可验证精确计算。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明模型在更复杂或非算术任务上的泛化能力，且依赖固定运行时和外部工作内存的设计可能限制应用范围。

papers.title: Co-Occurrence Priors Override Visual Spatial Evidence: Understanding False Alarms in Vision-Language Models for Construction Struck-By Hazard Detection
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly support construction hazard monitoring, yet their frequent false alarms remain poorly understood. This study investigates whether false struck-by hazard warnings arise from failures in object recognition, spatial relation encoding, or hazard decisions dominated by learned co-occurrence priors. We evaluated Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B using 355 counterfactual worker-excavator scene pairs with controlled spatial proximity and worker-removal variants, combining behavioral analysis, internal representation probing, causal interventions, and decision correction. Both models recognized the entities and encoded their spatial relations (out-of-fold AUROC: 0.82 and 0.91), assigning higher hazard scores to near than far scenes in 79% and 73% of pairs. Nevertheless, 74% and 100% of far scenes were falsely classified as hazardous. Removing the worker reduced Qwen's hazard rate to 11%, while worker presence exerted 2.4- and 3.2-times greater influence on hazard scores than spatial proximity in the respective models. Attention-head interventions, neuron-level interventions, and activation steering failed to eliminate this co-occurrence bias. However, conditioning hazard decisions on the model's own spatial-relation representation improved Qwen's specificity from 0.36 to 0.58 at matched sensitivity, outperforming threshold recalibration. These findings reveal that VLM struck-by false alarms stem primarily from decision-making failures rather than deficiencies in object recognition or spatial encoding, suggesting that future efforts should prioritize conditioning hazard decisions on encoded spatial evidence rather than further improving visual recognition alone.

summary.takeaway: 研究发现视觉语言模型在建筑撞击危险检测中的误报主要源于决策阶段受共现先验主导，而非物体识别或空间关系编码失败。
summary.methods: 评估Qwen2.5-VL-7B和InternVL3.5-8B在355对反事实工人-挖掘机场景上的表现，结合行为分析、内部表示探测、因果干预和决策校正。
summary.relevance: 属于多模态学习与跨模态理解，揭示视觉语言模型在安全关键场景中的决策偏差。
summary.caveat: 仅针对两类模型和特定建筑危险场景，结论的普适性需进一步验证；摘要未提供跨数据集或真实部署的评估。

papers.title: Single-cell foundation models transfer across deep evolutionary distances
papers.abstract: Single-cell foundation models are trained mostly on human and other vertebrate cells, yet are proposed as general-purpose models. Whether they transfer far beyond their training species is unknown. We evaluated zero-shot embeddings from Geneformer, scGPT and UCE against PCA and scVI in developmental atlases of Dictyostelium discoideum and Caenorhabditis elegans, separated from humans by 1.2 billion and 600 million years. Without retraining, the models recovered developmental order and preserved organism-specific cell identities. UCE encodes genes by protein sequence and could use 97% of measured genes, whereas Geneformer and scGPT, after ortholog mapping, used under one-fifth. UCE performed most consistently, often exceeding species-native baselines. Restricted to ortholog-mappable genes, it still scored above vocabulary-based models on five of six annotation tasks, some narrowly. Foundation models can thus yield informative cell embeddings across more than a billion years of evolution, and protein-sequence gene representations make these embeddings more complete and often more accurate.

summary.takeaway: 单细胞基础模型（Geneformer、scGPT、UCE）的零样本嵌入可跨越大进化距离（超10亿年）迁移，UCE因基于蛋白质序列编码基因而表现更一致。
summary.methods: 在盘基网柄菌和秀丽隐杆线虫的发育图谱上评估零样本嵌入，与PCA和scVI比较；UCE利用蛋白质序列编码基因，Geneformer和scGPT需直系同源映射。
summary.relevance: 直接关联Cell Foundation Model与预训练主题，探讨基础模型的跨物种泛化能力。
summary.caveat: 仅评估三种模型和两个物种；部分任务上UCE优势狭窄，且性能依赖直系同源映射质量。

papers.title: PlantVLM-Edge: Quantized Vision-Language Models for On-Device Crop Health Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is essential for sustainable agricultural production, yet accurate diagnosis often requires expert knowledge that is not readily available. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, and natural-language interaction, creating new opportunities for intelligent crop health assessment. However, deploying VLMs on resource-constrained devices remains challenging due to their substantial computational and memory requirements. This paper presents PlantVLM-Edge, a quantized vision-language framework for conversational crop health diagnosis that can run entirely on resource-constrained edge devices. PlantVLM-Edge combines agricultural domain adaptation, post-training quantization, and on-device serving with an offline chat interface, allowing growers to ask open-ended questions and receive diagnoses, symptom explanations, and management guidance without cloud connectivity. The framework is backbone-agnostic: we validate it with two different VLM types with varying scale and architecture (Qwen3-VL-2B and LLaVA-1.5-7B), four quantization schemes, and two diagnostic domains (plant diseases and insect pests), and we deploy all variants on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Eight-bit quantization affects answer quality minimally relative to the full-precision model, and 4-bit activation-aware weight quantization (AWQ) retains 98.6% of full-precision answer quality on both domains while reducing the weight memory of the 2B backbone by 49%. In its most compact form, PlantVLM-Edge requires 2.01 GiB of weight memory, returns its first token in about 0.12 s, and completes a 64-token diagnostic response in 0.78 s. These results demonstrate that timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is practical on edge devices, providing a foundation for next-generation crop monitoring and decision support systems.

summary.takeaway: 提出PlantVLM-Edge，一个量化视觉语言框架，可在资源受限边缘设备上完全离线运行，实现对话式作物健康诊断。
summary.methods: 结合农业领域适应、训练后量化和设备端服务；验证Qwen3-VL-2B和LLaVA-1.5-7B两种架构、四种量化方案和两个诊断域，部署于NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin。
summary.relevance: 涉及多模态学习与跨模态理解，展示视觉语言模型在边缘计算场景的实用化。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告与领域专家诊断的对比，量化对罕见病害的影响未评估；仅测试两种模型和两个诊断域。

papers.title: Learning Where to Look: Observation Policy Optimization for Thinking with Images
papers.abstract: Complex visual question answering often requires vision-language models to think with images, i.e., actively acquire local visual evidence by zooming into informative regions of high-resolution images. Our error analysis shows that many failures in this setting originate from incorrect observation actions, where the model fails to localize key regions or obtain crops that contain sufficient evidence for answering. We further observe that bounding-box tokens exhibit substantially higher generation entropy than ordinary language tokens, indicating high uncertainty when the model decides where to look. However, existing reinforcement learning methods based on final-answer rewards provide only trajectory-level feedback, making it difficult to assign precise credit to the observation actions. We propose Observation Policy Optimization (OPO), an RL algorithm for optimizing observation actions in tool-augmented thinking with images. OPO consists of two core modules. First, Uncertainty-Guided Observation Branching (UOB) treats each image zoom-in tool call as an observation event and selectively branches at high-uncertainty, low-redundancy events during rollout, enabling efficient exploration of alternative cropping decisions and their resulting visual evidence. Second, Evidence-Localized Advantage Attribution (ELAA) compares sibling branches using local evidence-sufficiency rewards and assigns credit only to the corresponding observation-action tokens. By decoupling observation-action optimization from trajectory-level outcome supervision, OPO improves visual evidence acquisition and further enhances visual reasoning performance. Experiments show that OPO consistently improves Qwen3-VL models across scales and achieves competitive performance against larger models and tool-augmented baselines. Code is publicly available.

summary.takeaway: 提出Observation Policy Optimization (OPO)，通过不确定性引导的观察分支和证据局部化优势归因，优化视觉语言模型在“用图像思考”中的观察动作。
summary.methods: 基于强化学习，包含UOB模块在高不确定性事件处分支探索替代裁剪，ELAA模块利用局部证据充分性奖励为观察动作令牌分配信用；在Qwen3-VL系列模型上实验。
summary.relevance: 结合强化学习与多模态学习，改进视觉语言模型的主动视觉证据获取。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体数据集名称和量化结果，仅提及在Qwen3-VL上一致提升；方法对工具调用接口的依赖可能限制泛化。

papers.title: Single-cell perturbation prediction near experimental reproducibility with GENESIS
papers.abstract: Single-cell perturbation atlases now measure cellular responses across millions of cells, but the number of possible combinations of biological contexts, perturbations, doses and other experimental variables make exhaustive measurements infeasible. Here, we present GENESIS (Generative ENErgy-based Single-cell Intervention Simulator), a generative framework that predicts single-cell response distributions directly from the covariates defining an experimental condition. GENESIS uses a lightweight neural network trained with the energy score, a strictly proper scoring rule for distributions. We introduce an experiment-calibrated evaluation framework in which prediction error is interpreted relative to the reproducibility of repeated measurements of the same condition. Across the Tahoe-100M small-molecule atlas and a large PBMC cytokine atlas, GENESIS significantly outperforms existing generative models and statistical baselines and approaches experimental reproducibility on independently repeated conditions. Importantly, GENESIS remains accurate when trained on only a fraction of the available experimental conditions or cells, and generated profiles recover experimentally observed context-dependent transcriptional programs. At comparable training-cell budgets, GENESIS achieves more accurate predictions when measurements span more experimental conditions rather than profiling fewer conditions more deeply. Together, these findings suggest a complementary strategy for perturbation studies: broader, lower-depth measurements can expand experimental coverage, while GENESIS augments sparsely sampled populations and predicts responses in unmeasured conditions.

summary.takeaway: 提出GENESIS生成框架，直接根据实验条件协变量预测单细胞响应分布，在Tahoe-100M和PBMC细胞因子图谱上接近实验重复性。
summary.methods: 使用轻量神经网络和能量得分（严格适当评分规则）训练；引入实验校准评估框架，将预测误差与相同条件的重复测量变异性比较。
summary.relevance: 关联单细胞扰动、多组学扰动主题，提供扰动响应预测的生成模型。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明模型在未见扰动类型或跨平台数据上的表现；评估限于两个图谱，结论需更多独立数据验证。

papers.title: Reconstructing Fraudulent Strategies in Online Payments via Interpretable Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Payment fraud causes financial losses and undermines users' trust in web payment services. Although fraud detection is a critical defense for payment security, complex and diverse fraudulent behaviors can still evade detection. Generating fraud samples for data augmentation can broaden detectors' coverage of different fraud patterns. However, existing methods matching the distribution of transaction attributes alone do not ensure that generated sequences preserve the sequential relationships among transaction choices, payment feedback, and subsequent behavioral adjustments. To this end, we propose PaySeqGen, an interpretable inverse reinforcement learning framework that reconstructs fraud behavior policies from fraudsters' observed payment trajectories. We design a mechanism for constructing candidate actions to support plausible payment sequence generation while enabling exploration. The framework also learns interpretable behavioral rewards that capture fraudsters' preferences across different transaction contexts. By alternating between reward learning and policy optimization, the framework reconstructs policies that generate new fraud sequences for detector augmentation and learns interpretable rewards supporting sequential fraud-pattern analysis in real trajectories. Experiments in real-world payment scenarios at Ant International, a leading global digital payment provider, show that PaySeqGen outperforms state-of-the-art generative augmentation methods. Reward-based trajectory analysis also identifies fraud patterns of practical value, helping analyst locating suspicious segments and examine multistep fraud tactics. Evaluation in the deployed system of online payment further confirms its effectiveness.

summary.takeaway: 提出PaySeqGen，一个可解释逆强化学习框架，从欺诈者支付轨迹中重建行为策略以生成欺诈序列，增强检测器并分析欺诈模式。
summary.methods: 设计候选动作构建机制支持合理支付序列生成；学习可解释行为奖励；交替进行奖励学习和策略优化；在Ant International真实支付场景中实验。
summary.relevance: 涉及强化学习与奖励学习，以及检索增强与对齐中的欺诈检测。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告生成序列的多样性或检测器在对抗适应下的鲁棒性；实际部署效果仅提及确认有效性，缺乏细节。

papers.title: Disagreement-informed arbitration for gene regulatory network inference: A score-level meta-classifier and a diagnostic typology of inter-method conflict.
papers.abstract: Gene regulatory network inference methods routinely disagree about individual edges, and practitioners resolve those conflicts by choosing one method or averaging them all. We ask whether the conflict can instead be arbitrated per edge. A gradient-boosted classifier is trained on the raw scores that ten inference methods-correlation-based, information-theoretic, sparse-regression and tree-ensemble, including GENIE3, GRNBoost2, CLR and ARACNe-assign to each candidate regulator-target pair, so that the weight given to each method varies from edge to edge. Across six single-cell perturbation screens spanning four cell types, arbitration improves on mean ensembling by +0.056 AUROC on Adamson and +0.083 on Shifrut under target-grouped cross-validation. The evaluation protocol turns out to matter more than the model. Edge-level cross-validation, standard in this literature, inflates apparent gains by 0.060 AUROC through target-gene leakage-comparable to the entire honest improvement. The effect is far larger for methods that represent genes implicitly: a supervised graph-attention link predictor trained on identical folds scores AUROC 0.930 under edge-level cross-validation, better than anything else we evaluate, and 0.533 once target genes are held out. Any method that parameterises genes is exposed, which covers most graph- and embedding-based approaches. A five-category typology of inter-method conflict localises where arbitration pays off, with the largest gains on edges where the methods disagree and the smallest where they already agree, while adding nothing as model input; we therefore report it as a diagnostic instrument rather than a modelling contribution. We also characterise what the ground truth measures: most perturbed genes in widely used screens are not transcription factors, and a mediation screen bounds how much of the perturbation response can be direct.

summary.takeaway: 提出基于得分级元分类器的逐边仲裁方法，整合十种基因调控网络推断方法的原始得分，并揭示边级交叉验证因目标基因泄漏而高估性能。
summary.methods: 训练梯度提升分类器，输入十种方法（包括GENIE3、GRNBoost2、CLR、ARACNe）的原始得分；在六个单细胞扰动筛选中采用目标基因分组交叉验证评估；提出五种冲突类型诊断工具。
summary.relevance: 关联单细胞扰动与GRN/Regulon主题，改进基因调控网络推断的集成策略。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出仲裁增益在诚实评估下有限，且冲突类型仅作为诊断工具而非模型输入；结论基于特定筛选数据集，需更广泛验证。

papers.title: EMBER: Contextualized gene representations enable compositional prediction across cellular perturbations
papers.abstract: Predicting the effects of individual and combined perturbations is central to identifying context-specific vulnerabilities and designing targeted interventions. Yet learning gene representations that integrate functional relationships with cellular state and transfer across perturbation tasks remains challenging. Here, we present EMBER, a gene-centric foundation model that learns context-dependent functional representations of genes. EMBER combines interaction-guided contrastive learning with masked expression reconstruction during pretraining on a single-cell corpus curated for diversity and balanced sampling across cell types and experimental batches. EMBER decouples gene representation learning from task-specific prediction through a composable embedding framework: the pretrained encoder remains frozen, while lightweight probes combine contextualized gene embeddings to predict individual and combined perturbation effects. The same pretrained representations support single-gene perturbation-response prediction, digenic interaction prediction, and multi-target drug-response prediction. EMBER improves cross-context perturbation-response prediction and genetic-interaction ranking relative to evaluated baselines. EMBER also prioritized SCFD1, a mediator of autophagosome-lysosome fusion, as a candidate dependency during mTOR inhibition. Together, these results establish contextualized gene embeddings as reusable building blocks for modeling genetic and pharmacological perturbations, supporting the prioritization of genetic interactions and context-specific interventions for experimental testing.

summary.takeaway: 提出基因中心基础模型 EMBER，学习依赖细胞状态的功能性基因表示，并以冻结编码器加轻量探针的组合式框架统一支持单基因、双基因组合及多靶点药物响应预测。
summary.methods: 在精选并跨细胞类型与实验批次平衡采样的单细胞语料上预训练，结合互作引导的对比学习与掩蔽表达重建；下游使用冻结编码器与轻量探针组合上下文基因嵌入进行预测。
summary.relevance: 与自监督/预训练及表示学习主题直接相关，展示如何将预训练表示复用于多个扰动预测任务。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称相对所评估基线有所提升，未给出具体指标数值；候选依赖 SCFD1 的发现尚需实验验证。

papers.title: Balancing Representations by Identifying and Generating Under-represented Data
papers.abstract: Self-supervised learning inherits the coverage of its source data. When an unlabeled corpus is long-tailed, the representation becomes dense around frequent modes and thin where coverage is weak. Objectives for long-tailed SSL reweight the images already in the corpus and add no new ones. We introduce BRIDGE (Balancing Representations by Identifying and Generating Under-represented Data), a label-free feedback loop around the source set. The current encoder scores every source image by its mean kNN distance, and a budgeted acquisition rule selects images from a band of that score distribution where support is thin and the generator still produces faithful variants. A frozen image-to-image diffusion model then adds local variants of the selected anchors, and pretraining continues on the enlarged source set. We formulate acquisition as recoverability-weighted allocation of local support and derive when a finite budget should favor a sparse band that excludes the extreme tail and when reallocation after each repair is optimal under a fixed objective. Across five long-tailed, web-scraped and synthetic source regimes, BRIDGE has the highest seven-task linear-probe and kNN average of the compared methods, and paired experiments extend the gain to ViT-S under contrastive and self-distillation objectives, to low-label fine-tuning and to semantic segmentation. The linear-probe gain is smaller under masked reconstruction. Generated repair matches an oracle that restores the withheld real images, and under a frozen encoder the inserted images shrink the neighborhoods of the selected anchors about twice as much as those of matched unselected images. BRIDGE needs no labels and leaves the pretraining objective unchanged, so it can be added to pretraining on uncurated web data, where the encoder decides which images to generate.

summary.takeaway: 提出无标签的反馈回路 BRIDGE，先识别长尾语料中表示支持稀薄的图像，再用扩散模型生成局部变体扩充源集，从而改善自监督表示的长尾覆盖。
summary.methods: 以编码器对每张源图像的平均 kNN 距离打分，按预算从分数分布中支持稀薄且生成仍可靠的区间选样；冻结的图像到图像扩散模型生成变体，继续在扩充后源集上预训练；并给出采集的可恢复性加权分配分析。
summary.relevance: 直接关联自监督与表示学习及预训练数据构建，属于检索增强/数据对齐式的预训练改进。
summary.caveat: 增益在掩蔽重建目标下较小；摘要未报告具体数值与计算开销，生成变体的真实性依赖冻结扩散模型。

papers.title: Gene Embedding Hub: a standardized resource for human gene representations
papers.abstract: Gene embeddings are vector representations of gene identity that provide machine-learning models with information from diverse biological sources. However, their use is hindered by a lack of standardization: inconsistent identifiers, formats, and preprocessing conventions. In this work, we present a unified resource of 67 human gene-embedding sets derived from protein, DNA and RNA sequences, biomedical text, bulk expression data, single-cell expression models, functional data, biological networks, knowledge graphs, regulatory genomics and multimodal models, covering up to 20,097 GENCODE-annotated protein-coding genes. The collection includes both published precomputed embeddings and representations generated or extracted from publicly available models and biological data. Each embedding set is organized in a folder containing the embedding matrix, the Ensembl gene identifiers, machine-readable metadata, and processing documentation. We validate the resource by measuring global and local similarity, cross-embedding consensus, and cross-embedding predictability. The collection is designed to allow community-contributed embeddings that meet predefined technical and documentation requirements, enables comparison of gene representations across modalities and provides standardized embeddings for training and downstream applications.

summary.takeaway: 发布标准化人类基因嵌入资源，统一 67 套基因嵌入的标识符、格式与预处理文档，覆盖最多 20,097 个 GENCODE 蛋白编码基因。
summary.methods: 汇集已发表预计算嵌入与从公开模型和生物数据生成或提取的表示，来源涵盖蛋白质/DNA/RNA 序列、文本、bulk 表达、单细胞表达模型、功能数据、网络、知识图谱、调控基因组与多模态模型；通过全局与局部相似性、跨嵌入一致性和跨嵌入可预测性进行验证。
summary.relevance: 与知识图谱及多模态学习主题相关，为跨模态基因表示的比较与下游训练提供标准化基础设施。
summary.caveat: 资源本身是数据与工具贡献，摘要未提供下游任务性能结论；社区贡献需满足预定义技术与文档要求。

papers.title: Assessing reinforcement learning and vigor with an online decision-making battery
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning and vigor are two fundamental aspects of decision-making modulated by dopamine. Although vigor is highly relevant for mood disorders, it has been overlooked by previous batteries characterizing decision-making abilities. We developed a test battery with two RL tasks (RL/working memory, go/no-go task) and two vigor tasks (physical effort discounting, foraging task) and administered it to an online community sample (N = 162). We used computational modeling and factor analysis to identify two factors reflecting RL and vigor. The RL factor reflected participants' general decision-making ability, while vigor corresponded to a motivational propensity to obtain rewards. Both factors demonstrated moderately strong test-retest reliability (ICC(2,1) = .65 and .67, respectively) over a one-to-two-week interval. Moreover, both factors were meaningfully related to self-report scales. The RL and vigor factors were negatively and positively associated with mania, respectively, although further analyses revealed that vigor was not fully independent of RL. Neither factor was significantly associated with depression symptoms. Collectively, we present preliminary evidence that vigor may represent a separate factor from RL in line with the putative dopamine hypothesis, paving the way for future longitudinal assessments of RL and vigor in mood disorders.

summary.takeaway: 构建包含两个强化学习任务与两个活力任务的在线决策测评组合，并在社区样本中识别出强化学习与活力两个因子。
summary.methods: N=162 在线样本完成 RL/工作记忆、go/no-go、体力努力折扣与觅食任务；使用计算建模与因子分析提取因子，并检验重测信度及与自评量表、躁狂和抑郁症状的关联。
summary.relevance: 与强化学习主题相关，评估决策中的强化学习成分，但非机器学习方法论文。
summary.caveat: 样本为在线社区样本、规模有限，属初步证据；活力因子未完全独立于强化学习；未发现与抑郁症状的显著关联。

papers.title: The Geometry of Ignorance: Detecting Suppressed Knowledge in LLMs through Activation Fragmentation
papers.abstract: Evaluating whether a large language model (LLM) genuinely knows a concept remains a fundamental problem, since behavioral metrics can be fooled by suppression: a model that refuses to answer may still harbor recoverable knowledge. The framework measures the geometric coherence of \textit{anon-vectors}, the differences in hidden states between a concept-specific query and its anonymized paraphrase, and shows that genuine knowledge forms a tight, low-entropy cluster while ignorance forces geometric fragmentation. Across ten instruction-tuned LLMs from three model families, all fragmentation metrics reliably separate known from unknown concepts, and post-unlearning, fragmentation geometry correlates with adversarial recovery across four attack types and five unlearning algorithms, though the direction of that relationship is shown to depend on attack methodology. Furthermore, a layer-resolved analysis reveals that different adversarial mechanisms exploit this geometry at varying depths, with high attack-specific correlations that are invisible to behavioral evaluation. Together, these results constitute a single-phase, attack-free proxy for unlearning robustness that captures aspects of parametric knowledge inaccessible to output-level metrics. A reference implementation is available at https://github.com/AdarPeleg/geometry-of-ignorance

summary.takeaway: 提出基于激活几何的检测框架，通过概念查询与其匿名化改写之间隐状态差（anon-vectors）的几何碎片化程度区分模型真正掌握与未知的概念。
summary.methods: 在三个模型家族的十个指令微调 LLM 上计算 anon-vector 的一致性/熵类碎片化指标；结合四种攻击与五种遗忘算法分析遗忘后的碎片化几何与对抗恢复的关系，并做逐层分析。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型与对齐主题，提供无需攻击的单阶段代理指标来评估参数知识的可恢复性与遗忘鲁棒性。
summary.caveat: 碎片化与对抗恢复关系的方向依攻击方法而异；代理指标与行为评估的对应仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: Collaborative Search Meets Large Language Models: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract: Collaborative search enables users to address complex information needs jointly. Advances in large language models (LLMs) enable autonomous agents to support collaborative information seeking within shared communication spaces. However, little is known about how these agents shape search experiences, behaviors, and outcomes compared with conventional search tools. We conduct a user study with 80 students working in 40 pairs. Each pair completes four collaborative search tasks under four scenarios: QAAgent, which answers queries using an LLM's parametric knowledge; CoSearchAgent, which uses multi-user conversational context to reformulate queries, retrieve web information, and generate source-grounded answers, while asking clarifying questions when needed; an in-chat search plugin that returns result lists; and manual Google Search. After each task, participants complete several questionnaires assessing their search experience and independently write a report; after all tasks, they participate in individual interviews. Results show that LLM-based agents reduce perceived workload, support collaboration, and reshape communication and evidence-use practices. They also encourage more independent paraphrasing, albeit at the cost of report richness. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic empirical comparison of LLM-based agents and conventional tools for collaborative search across search experience, user behavior, and collaborative outcomes.

summary.takeaway: 通过用户研究系统比较 LLM 智能体与传统工具在协作搜索中的体验、行为与结果差异。
summary.methods: 80 名学生组成 40 对，每对在四种条件下完成四项协作搜索任务：QAAgent（仅用参数知识）、CoSearchAgent（多用户对话上下文改写查询、检索并给出带来源答案、必要时澄清）、聊天内搜索插件、手动 Google 搜索；任务后填问卷并独立撰写报告，全部任务后访谈。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型与检索增强及对齐主题，考察智能体化检索协作的实际影响。
summary.caveat: 样本为学生配对、任务规模有限；结果显示报告丰富度下降等权衡，结论向其他人群与场景的外推需谨慎。

papers.title: AdSteer: Native Advertising in Large Language Model Generation
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) services face rapidly rising serving costs. To sustain free or affordable access for a broad user base, alternative monetization mechanisms are needed. Native advertising offers a promising approach, as it creates economic value by aligning user intent with merchant offerings. Yet how to integrate sponsored content naturally into LLM responses remains largely underexplored. Existing approaches primarily rely on prompt-level injection, multi-pass rewriting, or fine-tuning, which can compromise response quality or introduce additional computational costs. We propose AdSteer, a lightweight decoding-time advertising framework that adaptively adjusts token probabilities to integrate contextually appropriate advertisement into responses. AdSteer calibrates the strength and duration of advertising influence, making sponsored content a natural part of the response. Experiments on GEM-Bench across three application scenarios show that AdSteer achieves an average improvement of 14.1% in overall score over the strongest baselines and 22.5% fewer total tokens on average than rewrite-based methods. These results demonstrate that AdSteer provides an effective and practical solution for native advertising in LLMs.

summary.takeaway: 提出解码时轻量广告框架 AdSteer，自适应调整 token 概率，将上下文相关的赞助内容自然融入 LLM 回复，无需提示注入、多次改写或微调。
summary.methods: 在解码阶段校准广告影响的强度与持续时间；在 GEM-Bench 的三个应用场景上与基线比较。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型及对齐主题，涉及生成内容中商业插入与回复质量的权衡。
summary.caveat: 摘要称总体得分平均提升 14.1%、token 数比改写方法少 22.5%，但评估限于 GEM-Bench；广告插入对真实用户体验与可信度的影响未涉及。

papers.title: Replay for LLM Continual Learning with Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) distills several domain experts into one student and is used in the post-training of recent large language models. It trains on all domains at once, so every expert must be available at the same time. In practice, capabilities often arrive one after another, and the experts of earlier domains may be gone when a new domain is learned. Distilling the experts in sequence then suffers from catastrophic forgetting of the earlier domains. Some recent pipelines store a snapshot after every stage and end with a multi-teacher recovery stage taught by all snapshots. The number of stored models then grows with the number of stages. Different from these pipelines, this paper formulates continual MOPD by what is kept from earlier stages and studies replay toward the previous student. Inside every stage, prompts of earlier domains are replayed with the student of the previous stage as their teacher, so neither earlier experts nor stage snapshots are kept. Two design choices of replay are explored. The replay budget of a stage is either shared among the earlier domains or fixed per earlier domain. Replay steps either distill the token distribution alone or add alignment of hidden states, region-pooled self-attention scores and value relations. A five-domain benchmark of logic, math, code, safety and instruction following is built from public experts of one 1.5B student. Experiments on its 14 benchmarks show that, without storing any snapshot, replay toward the previous student closes most of the gap between sequential distillation and joint MOPD. With a fixed replay share per earlier domain, it performs on par with recovery from all stored snapshots.

summary.takeaway: 将多教师在线策略蒸馏重构为持续学习问题，提出向上一阶段学生回放旧域提示，从而无需保留早期专家或阶段快照即可缓解灾难性遗忘。
summary.methods: 每阶段用上一阶段学生作为旧域提示的教师进行回放；探索两种回放预算分配（跨旧域共享或每旧域固定）与两种蒸馏目标（仅 token 分布或加隐状态、区域池化自注意力分数与价值关系对齐）；构建逻辑、数学、代码、安全、指令遵循五域基准，基于 1.5B 学生的公开专家，评测 14 个基准。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型与持续学习主题，也涉及蒸馏中的表示对齐。
summary.caveat: 实验限于单一 1.5B 学生模型与五个自建领域；摘要未给出具体分数，固定回放份额与全快照恢复持平而非超越。

papers.title: BRIDGE: Biological Antimicrobial Resistance Inference via Domain-Knowledge Graph Embeddings
papers.abstract: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a growing global health crisis, responsible for an estimated 1.27 million deaths in 2019 alone. Traditional approaches to identifying antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) are often labour-intensive and limited in their ability to detect novel resistance mechanisms. In this study, we propose BRIDGE, a knowledge graph-based framework, to improve AMR gene prediction by integrating gene neighbourhood information and protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks. Focusing on Klebsiella pneumoniae and Escherichia coli, we con- struct a comprehensive and biologically grounded knowl- edge graph using curated data from CARD, STRING, and DrugBank. We apply knowledge graph embedding models which are fed into neural networks to infer novel AMR links, achieving classification accuracy of up to 97%. Our results demonstrate that incorporating biologically meaningful re- lationships, such as gene neighbourhood information and PPIs, enhances the predictive accuracy and interpretability of AMR link predictions. This work contributes to the de- velopment of scalable and data-integrated approaches for advancing antimicrobial resistance surveillance and drug discovery. BRIDGE implementation and data are available at https://github.com/GraphML-lab/BRIDGE.

summary.takeaway: 提出BRIDGE知识图谱框架，融合基因邻域与蛋白互作信息用于抗菌药耐药基因预测，报告分类准确率最高达97%。
summary.methods: 基于CARD、STRING和DrugBank整理数据构建面向Klebsiella pneumoniae与Escherichia coli的生物知识图谱，采用知识图谱嵌入模型接入神经网络推断新的AMR关联。
summary.relevance: 直接对应知识图谱与图谱构建表示主题，展示如何将领域知识结构化为图并用于表示学习与链接预测。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告最高分类准确率，未给出与具体基线的对照、数据划分细节或对新耐药机制的独立验证；性能提升与可解释性增益的量化证据有限。

papers.title: From Natural Language to Exact Cover: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach to Zebra Puzzles
papers.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation has substantially improved the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) on complex reasoning tasks, including code generation, data analysis, and exam-style question answering. Despite these advances, purely neural LLMs continue to struggle with elementary logical reasoning problems and lack the determinism, soundness, and reliability characteristic of symbolic reasoning systems. Conversely, classical symbolic methods such as SAT solving and exact cover guarantee correctness and completeness, but require problems to be expressed in highly specialized formal encodings, limiting their applicability to natural language inputs. In this work, we present a synergistic neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by combining neural semantic parsing with deterministic exact cover reasoning. Given a Zebra-style logic puzzle in natural language, an LLM translates entities and constraints into structured tool calls that construct an exact cover instance. A symbolic solver then computes the solution and provides feedback to iteratively refine invalid, under- or overconstrained encodings, exploiting the uniqueness property of Zebra puzzles. We conduct a comprehensive empirical evaluation across multiple parameter scales, post-training paradigms, and LLM families. The results demonstrate that our hybrid approach consistently outperforms strong plain neural baselines, including CoT prompting, as well as recent neuro-symbolic methods.

summary.takeaway: 提出神经-符号框架，由LLM将自然语言斑马谜题解析为精确覆盖实例，再由确定性符号求解器求解并反馈迭代修正编码。
summary.methods: 利用大语言模型做语义解析并生成结构化工具调用以构建exact cover实例，符号求解器计算结果并对欠约束或过约束编码提供反馈；在多参数规模、后训练范式和LLM家族上做实证评估。
summary.relevance: 与知识图谱构建与表示及大语言模型主题相关，体现将LLM输出约束为结构化表示以提升推理可靠性。
summary.caveat: 评测集中于Zebra风格逻辑谜题这一受控任务，摘要未说明向开放域或噪声自然语言推理的泛化能力。

papers.title: Follow the Features: SAE Feature-Guided Data-Efficient Instruction-Tuning of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Selecting small, effective instruction-tuning datasets requires identifying which aspects of the original data to retain. We introduce Follow the Features (FtF), a data-selection method that uses sparse autoencoder (SAE) features to characterize training data and guide subset construction. FtF ranks features using dataset-level activation statistics, scores samples by their expression of highly ranked features, and incorporates feature resampling to encourage diversity. The LLM-SAE pair used for selection is independent of the model being fine-tuned, enabling reuse across target models. We evaluate FtF on two model-dataset settings at a training budget of 100 samples with a fixed sequence length of 256 tokens. FtF achieves performance competitive with GRAPE and S2L, with relative rankings varying across settings. On Qwen 3 8B trained on Alpaca, FtF exceeds full-dataset training by 1.59 percentage points in the harmonic mean of an AlpacaEval-based win rate and Open LLM Leaderboard performance, although full-dataset training retains a higher Leaderboard score. These results support SAE feature statistics as a useful signal for data-efficient instruction tuning.

summary.takeaway: 提出FtF，用稀疏自编码器特征刻画训练数据并指导小规模指令微调子集选择。
summary.methods: 按数据集级激活统计对SAE特征排序，依据样本对高排名特征的表达打分，并加入特征重采样以促进多样性；选择所用LLM-SAE对与被微调模型解耦，在100样本预算、256 token序列长度下于两个模型-数据集设置评估。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与检索增强对齐主题，涉及以表示学习信号指导数据选择与对齐训练。
summary.caveat: 仅在100样本的紧预算和两个设置下评估，结果与GRAPE、S2L互有胜负；在Qwen 3 8B+Alpaca上仅在调和平均指标超过全量训练1.59个百分点，而Leaderboard分数仍低于全量训练，结论的普适性有限。

papers.title: Query-based Submodular Data Selection for Efficient Instruction Tuning
papers.abstract: As large language models are fine-tuned for increasingly specialized tasks, their performance depends more on which training examples are selected than on how many. Given a large heterogeneous training pool and a small target set specifying the desired capability, targeted data selection aims to find a compact subset that maximizes downstream performance. Existing methods score each candidate independently against the target and select the top-ranked examples, yet this point-wise strategy ignores inter-example interactions: at tight budgets the selected subset is dominated by near-redundant points that waste capacity on overlapping information. We propose Query-based Submodular functions with Gradient-guided Synthesis (QSGS), which formulates targeted selection as a submodular graph cut over a gradient similarity graph. A modular relevance term pulls selected examples toward the target task, while a pairwise dispersion penalty suppresses intra-subset redundancy. The resulting objective balances target relevance and intra-subset redundancy using the same formulation across different selection budgets. Empirically, the benefit of diversity-aware selection becomes increasingly pronounced as the data budget decreases. To further close coverage gaps that no selection from existing data can bridge, we introduce a gradient-guided synthesis step that identifies under-covered target directions via residual subspace analysis and generates synthetic examples to fill them. Experiments on MMLU, BBH, and TydiQA across Llama-2, Llama-3, and Mistral, show that QSGS at a 0.5% budget matches or exceeds full-data performance on Mistral-7B, outperforms the strongest baseline across all benchmarks, and yields increasing gains as the budget shrinks.

summary.takeaway: 提出QSGS，将目标数据选择建模为梯度相似图上的子模图割，兼顾目标相关性与子集内冗余抑制，并加入梯度引导的合成样本填补覆盖缺口。
summary.methods: 目标函数由模块化相关性项与成对分散惩罚项组成，预算变化时沿用同一形式；通过残差子空间分析识别覆盖不足方向并生成合成样本；在MMLU、BBH、TydiQA上以Llama-2、Llama-3、Mistral评估。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与检索增强对齐主题，关注指令微调中的数据选择效率与覆盖。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体预算下的绝对性能数值与计算开销；合成样本的有效性及对评测集泄漏风险未说明。

papers.title: Cumulative and Audited Guardrail Tool Evolution for LLM Agent Safety
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in open-world environments where safety risks cannot be fully predefined. However, most existing guardrail mechanisms remain static, relying on fixed rules, prompts, or classifiers that generalize poorly to emerging risks. Here we present EVOLVE, a tool-level self-evolving defense framework that formulates agent security as a process of cumulative security evolution. Inspired by how human societies transform experiences into transferable protective knowledge, EVOLVE externalizes security knowledge into executable guardrail tools that are continuously inherited, independently audited, and iteratively refined through lifelong interaction. Across multiple benchmarks, backbone models, and embodied environments, EVOLVE consistently outperforms existing defenses across diverse risk scenarios with +22\% average F1 score. We further validate the framework in real-world robotic and autonomous agent systems. Our results suggest that scalable agent safety may require continuously evolving defense systems rather than static guardrails.

summary.takeaway: 提出EVOLVE，将LLM智能体安全防御外化为可继承、可审计、可迭代精炼的护栏工具，形成累积式安全演化。
summary.methods: 以工具级自演化框架组织防御知识，在多个基准、骨干模型和具身环境中评估，并在真实机器人与自主智能体系统中验证。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与对齐主题，涉及智能体部署阶段的安全对齐与防护。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出平均F1提升22%的总体数字，未说明各基准细节、基线配置及真实环境验证规模；演化过程是否引入新的失效模式未讨论。

papers.title: Geometric Morphology Learning: Empowering Foundation Models from Structure to Spacetime Intelligence
papers.abstract: Geometry is the very form that connects space, time, and matter, serving as the fundamental fabric of the physical world, from continuous fields to discrete structures. Despite its importance, deep learning is inherently blind to geometry. Riemannian geometry stands as a well-established mathematical foundation for studying geometry, yet it remains largely incompatible with deep learning architectures. To bridge this gap, we establish a new learning framework--Geometric Morphology Learning--that learns geometric or topological structures, shapes or conformations for representation learning, reasoning and action modeling. Moving beyond early attempts limited to specific geometric priors, this theory centers on modeling the intrinsic geometry of objects and learning from such geometric or topological knowledge. Specifically, we construct a neural bundle, a unified scaffolding linking local and global structures, and formulate differentiable operators, including connection and curvature, thereby enabling the study of geometry with advanced geometric concepts such as holonomy and cohomology. Consequently, Geometric Morphology Learning opens new horizons in foundation models, reasoning and planning, graph modeling, physical simulation, PDE systems, and dynamics, marking a fundamental shift toward instilling systematic geometry in artificial intelligence.

summary.takeaway: 提出几何形态学习框架，旨在让模型学习对象内在几何与拓扑结构，统一局部与全局结构表示。
summary.methods: 构建neural bundle作为连接局部与全局结构的统一支架，定义connection与curvature等可微算子，从而引入holonomy、cohomology等几何概念。
summary.relevance: 对应预训练与自监督表示学习主题，提出面向几何与拓扑结构的表示学习理论框架。
summary.caveat: 摘要以理论框架与愿景为主，未提供具体实验设置、数据集或量化结果，实际有效性尚待实证。

papers.title: A Conditional Mutual Information Analysis of Response Variety in Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models provide a variety of responses at inference (generation) that conventionally depend on a temperature parameter. Using a conditional mutual information approach, a quantitative, entropy based analysis of response variety is given. Three limiting behaviors are defined: arbiter, independent (conditionally) and neutral (deterministic) that span no to maximal mutual information. We give examples of each behavior and suggest their application to: temperature analysis, language analysis, prompt compression, and knowledge graphs.

summary.takeaway: 用条件互信息与熵给出语言模型推理响应多样性的定量分析，定义arbiter、条件独立和确定性三类极限行为。
summary.methods: 基于条件互信息的熵分析框架，给出三类行为示例，并讨论其在温度分析、语言分析、提示压缩和知识图谱中的应用。
summary.relevance: 同时关联大语言模型与知识图谱主题，涉及生成多样性的信息论刻画。
summary.caveat: 摘要为分析性工作，未报告实验数据或规模；所述应用方向为建议性质，缺乏验证。

papers.title: Factor-Augmented Neural Conditional Density Estimation with Application to Drug Response Prediction.
papers.abstract: High-dimensional pharmacogenomic data pair thousands of molecular features with hundreds of cancer cell lines, complicating conditional density estimation. We study factor-augmented CINDES, which estimates conditional response densities from principal-component scores through binary classification. For an honest pilot/main-sample construction, assuming fresh-score PCA recovery, we derive a risk bound separating conditional-density learning, PCA score error, and representation bias. This guarantee does not cover the implemented procedure, which reuses observations for PCA and CINDES. In favorable strong-factor simulations, PCA improved a fixed CINDES pipeline, but PCA-MDN achieved lower negative log-likelihood (NLL) and integrated L 1 error in the matched comparison. Stress tests showed losses from omitted response-relevant low-variance directions and weak factor recovery, with sample-size-dependent factor-count effects. Across all 692 eligible source-specific genomics of drug sensitivity in cancer (GDSC) units and five splits, mean held-out NLL was 1.5414 for PCA-CINDES, versus 1.5661 and 1.5557 for ElasticNet and PCA/Ridge Gaussian models; PCA-MDN was better at 1.5156. A previously fixed 35-unit audit favored PCA-CINDES over Raw-X CINDES (mean paired NLL difference - 0 . 178 ) and found lower measured computational cost. The evidence supports PCA compression when retained factors capture response information and are accurately estimated; it does not establish robustness to general nonlinear or nonfactor structures, or CINDES as the preferred second-stage estimator. The application concerns preclinical prediction rather than clinical utility.

summary.takeaway: 研究factor-augmented CINDES，用主成分得分的二分类估计条件响应密度，并给出分离密度学习、PCA得分误差与表示偏差的风险界。
summary.methods: 在722个GDSC单元与五个划分上比较PCA-CINDES、ElasticNet、PCA/Ridge高斯模型与PCA-MDN，并进行强因子模拟、压力测试和35单元审计。
summary.relevance: 对应药物扰动机制主题，涉及药基因组高维特征压缩与药物响应预测。
summary.caveat: 理论保证不覆盖实际重用观测的PCA+CINDES流程；PCA-MDN的NLL更低（1.5156 vs 1.5414），压力测试显示遗漏低方差响应相关方向和弱因子恢复会带来损失，且结论限于临床前预测。

papers.title: Knowledge Graph Lakehouse: A Cloud-Native Architecture for Managing Enterprise Knowledge Graphs at Scale
papers.abstract: Modern data architectures for integrating heterogeneous data sources to discover actionable knowledge include the data warehouse, the data lake, and the data lakehouse, which combines the flexibility of the data lake with the structured data management capabilities of the data warehouse through metadata, indexes, and caching. Enterprise knowledge graphs (KGs) offer an alternative approach to such integration for the purposes of data analysis, but handling them at scale must address the Three Vs of big data: volume, velocity, and variety. Contextualized KGs (CKGs) meet part of that challenge by enriching facts with contextual information, yet many applications require only a context-specific subset of that knowledge. We propose the Knowledge Graph Lakehouse (KG Lakehouse), a cloud-native microservice architecture that adapts the data lakehouse paradigm for management of CKGs at scale. The KG Lakehouse indexes incoming source documents along configurable context dimensions and stores these documents in a data lake, from which application-specific CKGs are constructed on demand instead of maintaining a single, monolithic KG. We realize the proposed architecture as a proof of concept, with independently deployable services built from established cloud technology; context dimensions and format-specific document handling enter as configuration, leaving the architecture independent of the application domain.
