We evaluate the implemented system in experiments on a distributed cluster deployment.

summary.takeaway: 提出知识图谱湖仓（KG Lakehouse）：一种云原生微服务架构，把数据湖仓范式用于规模化、语境化知识图谱的管理。它按上下文维度索引源文档并存入数据湖，再按需构建应用特定的图谱，不再维护单一庞大的KG。
summary.methods: 把数据湖仓范式迁移到语境化知识图谱（CKG）管理：用可配置的上下文维度对传入源文档建立索引并存入数据湖，按需生成应用特定的CKG；用成熟的云技术构建可独立部署的服务，作为概念验证，并在分布式集群部署上做实验评估。
summary.relevance: 直接对应知识图谱主题，讨论大规模企业知识图谱的存储、索引与按需构建架构。
summary.caveat: 摘要只说明已实现概念验证并在分布式集群上实验，未给出具体性能、规模或对照基线结果，架构的实际收益与可扩展性数值无法从摘要判断。

papers.title: RAHC: Rule-Augmented Hyper-Relational Knowledge Graph Completion for Materials Synthesis
papers.abstract: Scientific discovery depends on reusing experimental knowledge, yet records scattered across papers and repositories are often incomplete. In materials synthesis, recovering missing conditions requires reasoning about the target material and the observed context of a specific experiment. Hyper-relational knowledge graphs (HKGs) represent this context through qualifiers, but existing completion methods leave domain knowledge and experimental regularities implicit. We propose RAHC, a rule-augmented HKG framework for single-slot and joint multi-slot synthesis-condition completion. RAHC builds a traceable rule catalog from training records and retrieved literature, retrieves rules for each query-candidate pair, and separately encodes graph structure and rule evidence. Hard rules constrain candidate validity, while soft rules guide ranking. RAHC-G aggregates rules using global reliability; RAHC-Q additionally learns query-specific relevance. Gated fusion combines structural and rule representations, while tuple-conclusion rules provide cross-condition evidence for joint completion. Experiments on five materials-synthesis datasets show improvements in single-slot and joint completion under Semi-inductive and Open-Answer Inductive settings, with Semi-inductive MRR gains of up to 15.6% over MAYPL. RAHC also improves performance on the entity-disjoint ILPC'22 Small benchmark, supporting transfer to fully inductive KG completion. These results support experimental condition selection, synthesis planning, and the reuse of scientific knowledge.

summary.takeaway: 提出RAHC，用规则增强的超关系知识图谱补全框架，支持材料合成条件的单槽与联合多槽补全，让领域知识与实验规律显式参与推理。
summary.methods: 从训练记录和检索文献构建可追溯的规则目录，为每个查询–候选对检索规则；分别编码图结构与规则证据，硬规则约束候选有效性、软规则引导排序；RAHC-G用全局可靠性聚合规则，RAHC-Q额外学习查询特定相关性；门控融合结构表示与规则表示，元组结论规则为联合补全提供跨条件证据。在五个材料合成数据集及ILPC'22 Small上评测。
summary.relevance: 面向知识图谱补全，且是超关系知识图谱与材料合成领域知识的结合，与知识图谱主题高度相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告Semi-inductive下MRR相对MAYPL最高提升15.6%，但未说明各数据集绝对性能、规则构建的成本与文献检索质量的影响；规则目录的构建依赖训练记录与检索文献，其可迁移性需看全文。

papers.title: DRAP: Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity for Continual Learning in Physical AI
papers.abstract: Continual learning in physical AI differs from conventional continual learning because small per-step policy errors can accumulate over a trajectory. Each deviation may move the agent outside the training distribution, increase subsequent prediction errors, and ultimately cause closed-loop task failure. This work introduces Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity (DRAP), a replay-free method that estimates the historical importance of adaptable model tensors from sample-level action gradients weighted by local trajectory-amplification risk. A ridge-regularized local linear model is fitted to expert state-action transitions, and the largest singular value of its state-transition matrix provides a policy-independent, Lyapunov-inspired estimate of one-step perturbation amplification. After each task, risk-weighted squared gradients are accumulated in a tensor-level importance memory. During subsequent tasks, DRAP uses normalized cumulative importance to scale the effective AdamW learning rate of each tensor, immediately reducing the plasticity of components that supported previous behavior at dynamically sensitive trajectory points. We instantiate DRAP on a fixed KappaTune-selected subnetwork of OpenVLA and evaluate replay-free sequential adaptation across the LIBERO Spatial, Object, and Goal suites. Compared with standard AdamW fine-tuning and EWC, the results show substantially improved retention of previously learned behaviors while preserving strong new-suite acquisition.

summary.takeaway: 针对物理AI中持续学习的小误差沿轨迹累积问题，提出DRAP：利用轨迹放大风险加权样本级动作梯度，估计张量历史重要性，并据此按张量调节有效学习率，实现无回放的持续适应。
summary.methods: 用岭正则化局部线性模型拟合专家状态–动作转移，以其状态转移矩阵最大奇异值作为策略无关的、受Lyapunov启发的单步扰动放大估计；每任务后把风险加权平方梯度累积到张量级重要性记忆，后续任务用归一化累积重要性缩放各张量的AdamW有效学习率。在OpenVLA的KappaTune选定子网络上，于LIBERO Spatial/Object/Goal上做无回放顺序适应，与AdamW微调和EWC对比。
summary.relevance: 属于持续学习方法，特点是结合轨迹动态风险而非仅参数重要性，契合持续学习主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要称保留旧行为明显改善且新任务获取仍强，但未给出量化指标；实验限于OpenVLA子网络与LIBERO三套件，向其他具身策略与真实物理环境的泛化性未在摘要中体现。

papers.title: Modulating Merging Strengths via Joint Loss Estimation for LoRA-based Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Continual learning (CL) aims to adapt models to new tasks while preserving previously learned knowledge. Recently, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), a representative Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) method, has gained increasing attention in CL due to its efficiency and scalability. Several LoRA-based merging methods maintain a single inference model by scaling the newly learned LoRA update with one coefficient and merging it into the previous weights after each task. However, they usually control the whole update with a shared scalar factor, although different update elements may affect previous and current tasks in different ways. To address this issue, we propose Merging Strength Modulation via Joint Loss Estimation (M2LE). It consists of Hessian Information-guided Adaptive Merging (HIM) and Task Simulation Perturbation for Merging (TSP). Instead of searching for a global merge coefficient, HIM directly solves for the target merged update under a joint objective over previous and current tasks. Solving this objective gives an analytic solution that naturally takes the form of element-wise modulation over the current task LoRA update. To improve the stability of the learned update under subsequent merging, we introduce TSP which simulates different tasks interference. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that M2LE consistently outperforms existing PEFT-based continual learning methods. Code is available at https://github.com/bbdeeer/M2LE_NeurIPS2026.

summary.takeaway: 提出M2LE，用联合损失估计来调制LoRA更新在合并时的强度，把全局合并系数替换为逐元素调制，以更好平衡新旧任务。
summary.methods: M2LE包含两部分：Hessian信息引导的自适应合并（HIM）在前任务与当前任务的联合目标下直接解析求解目标合并更新，解自然表现为对当前任务LoRA更新的逐元素调制；任务模拟扰动（TSP）模拟不同任务干扰以提升合并后更新的稳定性。在多个基准上与现有PEFT持续学习方法比较。
summary.relevance: 直接属于基于LoRA参数高效微调的持续学习，关注合并式防遗忘。
summary.caveat: 摘要只称在多个基准上一致优于现有PEFT持续学习方法，未列数据集名称与具体数值；Hessian相关计算开销与可扩展性未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: DLER: Dual-Logit Experience Replay for Online Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Online continual learning aims to continuously train neural networks on a non-stationary data stream in a single pass. Rehearsal-based methods alleviate catastrophic forgetting by replaying stored samples, but the imbalance between current and previous data often leads to predictions biased toward current classes. Many approaches have been proposed to overcome the forgetting problem by correcting the bias; however, they still need to be improved in an online fashion. By decomposing the dot-product logits into an angle factor and a norm factor, our analysis reveals that the angle factor efficiently captures novel knowledge but is particularly susceptible to prediction bias, whereas the norm factor helps preserve historical knowledge. Based on these observations, we propose Dual-Logit Experience Replay (DLER), which exploits dual-logits for both model optimization and memory management. Specifically, DLER learns current samples using cosine logits and incorporates additional dot-product logits when replaying previous samples to mitigate prediction bias. To strengthen dual-logit learning under limited replay memory, an auxiliary supervised contrastive objective promotes angular compactness within each class, extending corrections learned from limited replay samples to other samples of the same class. Meanwhile, we introduce a memory update strategy that preferentially retains samples for which dot-product prediction assigns a higher probability to the correct class than cosine prediction, aligning sample selection with dual-logit training. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of DLER, particularly under limited memory budgets.

summary.takeaway: 提出DLER，把点积logit分解为角度因子与范数因子后，用双logit分别优化模型与管理回放记忆，以缓解在线持续学习中对当前类的预测偏置。
summary.methods: 分析发现角度因子善于捕获新知识但易受预测偏置影响、范数因子有助于保留历史知识；据此DLER在学当前样本时用余弦logit，回放旧样本时额外引入点积logit以减轻偏置；加入辅助监督对比目标增强类内角度紧致性，把有限回放样本学到的校正扩展到同类其他样本；记忆更新策略优先保留点积预测比余弦预测给正确类更高概率的样本。在三个数据集上实验。
summary.relevance: 属于在线持续学习中的回放式防遗忘方法，与持续学习主题直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要称在三个数据集、尤其有限内存预算下有效，但未给出数据集名称与量化结果；方法依赖对比目标与双logit，超参数敏感性需看全文。

papers.title: What Is the Influence of Task Order in Continual Learning? An Empirical Study and Order-Aware Evaluation for Motion Forecasting
papers.abstract: Aggregate scores for continual learning algorithms rest on a distribution over task orders that is rarely stated. We formulate algorithm comparison as an expectation over a declared order distribution, which separates training variation from order variation, and apply it to motion forecasting with four road-layout tasks from the INTERACTION dataset, all 24 task orders, four algorithms, and three training replicates (288 runs). Task order accounts for 65\% to 91\% of the variation in current-task error and backward transfer, and 90\% to 99\% of this order effect comes from the identity of the starting task: the smallest task cannot be learned from a cold start. Beyond the first stage, the order effect is comparable to training variability. In most orders, the leading algorithm in current-task error and backward transfer is within one replicate standard deviation of the runner-up. Backward transfer depends on the order mainly through its reference term, which weights the first task most heavily, so relative improvement and final error identify different leading algorithms for displacement error. A transition-direction descriptor computed from task statistics tracks the position of the smallest task, and weighting orders by it leaves the algorithm ranking unchanged. These results call for benchmarks that declare their order distribution and report order-resolved, starting-task-resolved, warm-start, and final errors alongside aggregate scores. The code and data are available \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/task-order-cl-4f7b/}{here}.

summary.takeaway: 通过把持续学习算法比较表述为对声明任务顺序分布的期望，实证表明在运动预测中任务顺序（尤其起始任务身份）主导当前任务误差与后向迁移的方差，并据此提出考虑顺序的评测建议。
summary.methods: 用INTERACTION数据集的四个道路布局任务，覆盖全部24种任务顺序、四种算法、三次训练重复共288次运行；分解训练变异与顺序变异，分析起始任务效应、后向迁移的参考项、转移方向描述子及按顺序加权后的算法排序。
summary.relevance: 属于持续学习的评测方法学研究，质疑聚合分数的可解释性，对持续学习基准设计有直接意义。
summary.caveat: 结论基于运动预测单一领域、四个任务与特定数据集，泛化到其他模态与任务集需验证；摘要为实证与评测框架，未提出新的学习算法。

papers.title: DCAF: Unifying Data Validity, Evaluation Validity and Predictive Modeling for Single-cell Perturbation Simulation
papers.abstract: Single-cell perturbation profiling is limited by cost and throughput, while computational methods remain constrained by inconsistent evaluation and underperformance relative to simple baselines. Here we present DCAF, a unified framework for single-cell perturbation simulation that that jointly addresses data validity, evaluation validity and predictive modeling. Among its three components, DCAF-data addresses the single-measurement limitation by reconstructing pre- and post-perturbation status using entropy-regularized optimal transport, and is demonstrated on both cell line and multi-cell type datasets. DCAF-criterion evaluates log fold changes in non-silenced genes to improve sensitivity to model error and robustness to zero inflation noise, validated on synthetic datasets. DCAF-model combines JEPA with explicit modeling for regulatory-dynamics modeling for interpretable prediction. Across benchmarks, DCAF outperforms state-of-the-art deep-learning methods, as well as mean and linear baselines in cross-gene, cross-cell-type and cross-region generalization. In adult Mouse brain, DCAF recapitulates known cell-type-specific regulatory heterogeneity of Dgcr8 knockdown at both cell type and gene levels. DCAF thus provides a rigorous and biologically grounded foundation for reliable perturbation simulation across development, disease and therapeutic discovery.

summary.takeaway: 提出DCAF统一框架，同时处理单细胞扰动模拟中的数据有效性、评估有效性与预测建模三个环节。
summary.methods: DCAF-data用熵正则最优传输重建扰动前后状态，以缓解单次测量限制，并在细胞系与多细胞类型数据上展示；DCAF-criterion基于非沉默基因的log fold change评估，以提升对模型误差的敏感性和对零膨胀噪声的稳健性，并在合成数据上验证；DCAF-model结合JEPA与显式调控动力学建模以做可解释预测。在跨基因、跨细胞类型、跨区域泛化基准上与深度学习及均值、线性基线比较，并在成年小鼠脑中分析Dgcr8敲低。
summary.relevance: 直接对应单细胞扰动主题，涉及扰动响应预测与评估方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要称超越现有深度学习方法与简单基线，但未给出具体指标数值；评估标准的有效性主要基于合成数据验证，真实数据上的偏差风险需看全文。

papers.title: BISECT: Bilevel Spectral Decomposition for Low-Rank Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Exemplar-free continual learning on pre-trained Vision Transformers increasingly relies on Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), yet prevailing methods govern the low-rank update space through strict subspace isolation. By projecting each incoming task into the approximate null space of historical token activations, isolation-based learners equate any cross-task feature overlap with catastrophic interference. We show that this orthogonality premise induces a structural bottleneck we term \emph{spectral starvation}: when down-projection bases are locked before task optimization, the gradient norm reaching the trainable up-projection is upper-bounded by the energy of current-task features captured by the chosen basis. Because natural visual tasks share low- and mid-level covariance structure, historical null tails contain barely $5.5\%$ of incoming task variance, starving new-class plasticity while blocking positive consolidation along shared directions. We propose BISECT (Bilevel Spectral Decomposition), a continual LoRA framework that partitions a fixed rank-$r$ budget into two orthogonal functional blocks: an invariant carrier spanned by the dominant modes of the joint historical-and-current Gram matrix, and a novelty complement extracted via generalized Rayleigh whitening followed by orthogonal complement projection. After single-task training, BISECT folds both blocks back into the frozen backbone using a closed-form precision gate that scales each rank-1 invariant atom by its current-to-joint Rayleigh ratio while preserving novelty atoms at unit gain. Across eight incremental settings on ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A, CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and DomainNet, BISECT outperforms prompt, adapter, and LoRA baselines with zero extra inference parameters or FLOPs, and remains complementary to sparse analytic expansion.

summary.takeaway: 指出基于LoRA的示例无关持续学习中严格子空间隔离会导致“谱饥饿”，并提出BISECT把固定秩预算分成不变载体与新颖补集两块，兼顾新类可塑性与共享方向的巩固。
summary.methods: 分析隔离式方法把跨任务特征重叠等同于灾难干扰，使历史零空间尾部仅含约5.5%的传入任务方差；BISECT用历史与当前联合Gram矩阵的主模态张成不变载体，经广义Rayleigh白化与正交补投影提取新颖补集；单任务训练后用闭式精度门把两块折回冻结主干，按当前对联合的Rayleigh比缩放各秩1不变原子，新颖原子保持单位增益。在ImageNet-R、ImageNet-A、CIFAR-100、CUB-200、DomainNet共八个增量设置上与prompt、adapter、LoRA基线比较。
summary.relevance: 属于预训练ViT上的低秩持续学习，直接契合持续学习主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要称零额外推理参数或FLOPs并优于基线，但未给出具体精度数值；5.5%方差统计的具体设定与适用条件需看全文，且方法依赖预训练ViT与固定秩预算。

papers.title: Expertise modifies neural responses to causal inference during language comprehension
papers.abstract: Linguistic communication relies on shared common ground, yet different individuals in a community have specialized semantic knowledge. As a key example, physicians acquire rich knowledge about the causes of illness. An open question is whether such "causal expertise" influences the neural basis of language comprehension. Here we tested the hypothesis that when understanding everyday language like, "Holly used a grimy faucet during her overseas plane ride. Now she has the stomach flu," medical experts retrieve richer representations in semantic networks of the brain. Physicians (n=16) and age- and education-matched controls (n=16) undergoing fMRI read two-sentence vignettes that elicited implicit causal inferences about illness or object mechanics as well as control vignettes that did not elicit causal inferences. Vignettes were linguistically matched across conditions and were accessible to experts and non-experts alike. Across both groups, causal vignettes about illness engaged a temporoparietal semantic network previously implicated in thinking about animates, i.e., people and animals (precuneus and left temporoparietal junction), whereas causal vignettes about object mechanics engaged a semantic network associated with places and objects. Critically, physicians' responses in the animacy network were more robust and self-similar, suggesting the activation of richer semantic knowledge. Medical expertise effects were specific to biological inferences rather than mechanical or mental state inferences. By contrast, individually localized frontotemporal language and frontoparietal reasoning networks did not respond preferentially to causally connected sentences or show effects of expertise. Our findings suggest that causal expertise alters neural responses to causal inferences that unfold automatically during language comprehension.

summary.takeaway: 医学专业知识会增强语言理解中自动发生的疾病因果推断所引发的语义网络反应，且这种效应特异于生物因果推断。
summary.methods: 16名医生与16名年龄和教育程度匹配的对照者接受fMRI，阅读两句话小故事，分别诱发对疾病或物体力学的隐含因果推断，并设无因果推断的对照故事；各条件在语言上匹配。比较两类因果故事激活的语义网络及专家效应。
summary.relevance: 该研究直接考察语言理解中因果推断的神经基础，并检验专业知识对机制（生物/机械）因果推理的影响，契合机制推理主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告16对参与者的小样本fMRI结果，未给出效应量；结论限于隐含因果推断范式与特定疾病/力学材料，不能外推到其他因果推理类型或更广泛人群。
